title: security: rbac v2 + audit logging + KMS region-pinning validation
author: Ava Martinez
body: Motivation: tighten RBAC v2 enforcement surface and ensure audit logs and KMS region-residency controls are validated at request time. This change addresses two customer-reported gaps: 1) RBAC v2 policy evaluation did not consider explicit KMS region pinning constraints and could allow key selection that violates a tenant's data residency policy; 2) audit logs did not include normalized KMS metadata required by compliance teams for downstream ingest. Summary of changes: added a KMS region-pinning validator to the RBAC v2 evaluation path; extended policy schema with optional kms.region and kms.residency constraints; enriched audit log records with kms_key_id, kms_region, and residency_decision fields; added server-side enforcement hook to reject requests that would violate an enforced residency policy and to emit an audit event in all cases (audit vs enforce modes respected). Updated unit and integration tests and added a Linear task reference for rollout. Checklist: - [x] Add kms.region and kms.residency attributes to RBAC v2 policy schema and validation - [x] Implement runtime checks in auth middleware to validate KMS region pinning against resource and policy - [x] Enrich audit events with consistent KMS metadata and residency decision - [x] Add migration script to backfill policy annotations for existing tenants (no-op if absent) - [x] Add unit tests for policy parsing and enforcement paths - [x] Add integration test exercising request rejection when residency enforced - [x] Update docs and release notes Implementation notes: this PR touches the policy parser (auth/rbac/v2/parser.py), the runtime policy evaluator (auth/rbac/v2/evaluator.py), the KMS adapter (integrations/kms/adapter.py) to surface region metadata, the audit logging pipeline (observability/audit/producer.py) to include normalized fields, and the migration tool (tools/migrations/add_kms_policy_annotations.py). The evaluator now short-circuits with a residency failure when a policy has "enforce":true and a requested KMS key's region does not match the policy residency. In audit mode the request is allowed but an audit entry is emitted with residency_decision=AUDIT_ONLY. Migration and rollout: default behavior for tenants without annotations is unchanged (backwards compatible). A migration script is included to annotate tenant policies with "kms.residency": "unspecified" where missing; site admins can run the migration as part of an upgrade. We will rollout with canary on Dedicated customers for 48 hours, monitor audit rate and rejection rate, then open to hosted tier. Testing: ran unit tests, integration tests against a local KMS mock, and end-to-end tests simulating enforced residency. CI run summary below.

review_comments: Samuel Cho: Please ensure evaluator short-circuits before any KMS calls to avoid extra latency on audit-only paths.
Ava Martinez: Updated evaluator to fetch key metadata lazily and added a fast-path for audit-only policies (no KMS call unless enforce=true).
Priya Nair: The policy schema change looks good, but we need a migration step for tenants using custom tooling. Can you add a no-op migration that annotates policies with 'unspecified'?
Ava Martinez: Added migration script and documented the admin workflow in docs/security/rbac-v2-kms-residency.md.
Liam O'Connor: CI flaked on e2e (timeout) in first run; can we increase the timeout and re-run? Also add a test for multi-region key aliasing.
Ava Martinez: Increased e2e timeout and added multi-region aliasing test. Re-ran CI and all checks passed.
release_notes: Security: RBAC v2 now supports optional kms.region and kms.residency constraints. Platform will enforce residency when policy specifies 'enforce:true' and will emit enriched audit events with KMS metadata. Backwards compatible default for tenants without annotations.
notes_for_ops: Run tools/migrations/add_kms_policy_annotations.py during upgrade to annotate policies. Monitor metric 'audit.residency.rejections' and alert if >0.5% of requests for 1h during canary. Canary window: 48h on Dedicated clusters.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: accidental request rejections for tenants with misconfigured policies. Mitigation: audit mode first, migration script, canary rollout, and immediate rollback plan (feature flag 'rbac_v2_kms_enforce').
changelog_entry: Added KMS region-residency enforcement and enriched audit logging for RBAC v2 policies.
